number_line: Twenty-two kilos of cocaine. Or so he thought.
gotcha: Colombian police had swapped the cocaine for blocks of wood.
person_line: Junaed Dar, a Heathrow security manager, came in three hours early.
consequence_line: A jury convicted him: sixteen and a half years, for bags of wood.
person_first: He ran security at Heathrow. Then he met the couriers.
